about: GTA 5 made $1 billion in 3 days (Take-Two estimate, Sept 2013); fastest films took 19 days; 230M+ sold-in by Aug 2026; GTA 6 Nov 19. Delta, pillar 1.

lines.text: A billion dollars. Three days. GTA 5.
lines.say: A billion dollars. Three days. G T A 5.

lines.text: That's Take-Two's own estimate, from September 2013.
lines.say: That's Take Two's own estimate, from September, twenty thirteen.

lines.text: They said no game or movie had ever been that fast.
The fastest movies back then took nineteen days.
And GTA 5 kept selling: over 230 million copies.
lines.say: And G T A 5 kept selling. Over two hundred thirty million copies.
G T A 6 comes out November nineteenth.

lines.text: Can it beat three days? Yes or no?
lines.say: Can it beat three days? Yes, or no?
